description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_CustomPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/custom-3d-model-print">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Sketches" name="Sketches sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Project draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RevisedDraft" name="Revised project draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Plastic order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Status" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CustomPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Plastic supplier"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D Printer"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Sketches" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Draft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Changes" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RevisedDraft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Participant_Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Need" name="Custom 3D model wanted"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to artist" messageRef="Msg_Sketches"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive project draft from artist" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Draft_Merge" name="Draft received"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with result?" default="Flow_NotSatisfied"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RequestChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Msg_Changes"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" name="Receive revised draft from artist" messageRef="Msg_RevisedDraft"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Color in stock at home?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_CheckAmount" name="Check remaining amount of plastic"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100g" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_100gOrMore"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Add plastic to shopping list"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic color" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_ReceiveOrderedPlastic" name="Receive ordered plastic"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on printer"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Print_Split" name="Start heating and gcode generation"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_HeatUp" name="Heat up bed and extruder"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status" messageRef="Msg_Status"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Temp_Check" name="Bed and extruder at target temperature?" default="Flow_NotReady"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate gcode file from STL"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Print_Join" name="Ready to print"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print model"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Printed" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Need" targetRef="SendTask_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSketches" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_Draft_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Draft_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="UserTask_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="SendTask_RequestChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_RequestChanges" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveRevisedDraft" targetRef="Gateway_Draft_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="UserTask_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="UserTask_CheckAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="SendTask_OrderPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="UserTask_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100g"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100g" name="Under 100 g" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100g" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_100gOrMore" name="100 g or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100g" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderPlastic" targetRef="ManualTask_ReceiveOrderedPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="ManualTask_ReceiveOrderedPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Plastic_Merge" targetRef="ManualTask_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="ManualTask_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_Print_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Print_Split" targetRef="ManualTask_HeatUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Print_Split" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="ManualTask_HeatUp" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus" targetRef="Gateway_Temp_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Temp_Check" targetRef="ReceiveTask_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Temp_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Print_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_Print_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Print_Join" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="EndEvent_Printed"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
